run_permute_mnist_training: run the permute MNIST continual learning experiment with EWC or A-GEM importance method via CLI
run_cross_validate_permute_mnist: run the permute MNIST experiment in cross-validation mode to dump accuracy results to a text file
run_single_epoch_training: run the permute MNIST training for a single epoch instead of fixed iterations per task
review_train_task_sequence: review the train_task_sequence function that trains a sequence of tasks using LLL methods like EWC or A-GEM
review_test_task_sequence: review the test_task_sequence function that evaluates model accuracy across all tasks in the sequence
